description: This file is a shell script for running performance benchmarks on an Android application, including measuring app launch times, screen rendering performance, and chat component performance via automated UI interactions and system diagnostics.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: require_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command is available in the system and exits if not.

methods.name: adb_cmd
methods.description: Executes an adb command, optionally specifying a device serial.

methods.name: dump_ui
methods.description: Dumps the current UI hierarchy to an XML file.

methods.name: ui_has
methods.description: Checks if a UI pattern exists in the current UI hierarchy.

methods.name: wait_for_pattern
methods.description: Waits until a specific UI pattern appears or times out.

methods.name: ensure_connected
methods.description: Verifies if the app has reached a connected state.

methods.name: ensure_screen_online
methods.description: Ensures the screen webview is loaded and ready.

methods.name: ensure_chat_online
methods.description: Ensures the chat component is loaded and ready.

methods.name: capture_mem
methods.description: Captures memory info for the app.

methods.name: start_cpu_sampler
methods.description: Starts sampling CPU usage over a set number of samples.

methods.name: summarize_cpu
methods.description: Generates a summary (average, median, peak) of CPU usage data.

methods.name: measure_launch
methods.description: Measures app launch time and connected status.

methods.name: run_screen_benchmark
methods.description: Runs the screen rendering benchmark, capturing performance metrics.

methods.name: run_chat_benchmark
methods.description: Runs the chat component performance benchmark.
